instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Refactor the 'PaperTrading.js' file to implement the new layout and styles.
2. Focus on the 'TradeDetailsModal' first as requested by the user.
3. Update the 'MetricCard' and other dashboard components to match the new aesthetic.
4. Ensure the 'Bento' grid layout is applied correctly to the main dashboard view.
5. Use the defined color palette and typography.
6. Add 'data-testid' attributes to all interactive elements.
7. Do NOT break existing functionality. The logic must remain the same.
8. Use 'lucide-react' icons as they are already imported.
9. For the 'TradeDetailsModal', use a 2-column or 3-column grid for the details to make it easier to scan.
10. Add a subtle noise texture to the main background if possible (using a CSS class or inline style).
universal_guidelines: Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
